text_excerpt: The Paperglow 3 is an excellent e-reader that handles the basics well. Its high-resolution display presents text with impressive clarity, and the adjustable warm light allows for comfortable reading at night. The battery life is excellent, lasting several weeks on a single charge. Water resistance makes it suitable for reading by the pool or in the bath. There are some minor drawbacks to the user experience, including store promotions and the removal of physical page-turning buttons. Library integration could be more streamlined. However, the reading experience is excellent, and its price is competitive within its category. It receives a strong recommendation for avid readers. The reading software smoothly handles highlights, notes, and dictionary searches, syncing notes across devices without any hassle. Font selection and design options meet most preferences, including adjustable margins and line spacing, which print enthusiasts appreciate. The device reads standard ebook formats and PDFs, although complex PDF designs with small text appear awkward on the six-inch screen. Parental controls are straightforward to configure. The storage capacity can hold thousands of titles, eliminating the need to actively manage a library. Adding dark mode for night reading would make the software package perfect.
